Simulation 1 provides a reference case for the slow-to-fast pathway. It asks how a fixed
contextual level changes symptom activation when the fast symptom network itself is unchanged.
Because P enters each symptom’s local input through γiP, a shift in activation is expected from

slow-to-fast effect against which the dynamic simulations that follow can be interpreted.
